methodology.name: Neon Tokyo Weekly JP Backtest v1
methodology.candidate_policy: Each weekly evaluation date is scored using only bars visible at that date. Only score-ranked Top 10 are retained.
methodology.entry_policy: Next trading day's open after the weekly evaluation date.
methodology.alpha_policy: Alpha equals stock return minus TOPIX ETF return for the same horizon. TOPIX returns above the absolute guard are invalidated.
